initial_attempt_disposition: Discarded before any cohort interpretation because joblib emitted InconsistentVersionWarning under both attempted single-version environments.
remediation: The full runner will emit model-independent N0/N5 response records. Fold 0/1 gates must be evaluated in the 1.7.2 environment and fold 2/3/4 gates in the 1.9.0 CUDA environment; a deterministic offline majority join then chooses an already-generated action without reading query labels.
policy: No PanNuke cohort statistic may use a gate vote produced under a mismatched deserialization environment.
